name: InterestingME Material Needs Furnace Patch
description: Adds Screen bronze compatibility, preserves all four InterestingME furnace grating variants, extends furnace structure validation for Material Needs Tier 1 full mudbricks and Bricklayers 3.2.2 full glazed bricks, fixes explosive drilling for Material Needs Geology rocks, adds slow manual crushing of single-layer coarse muck with selected vanilla hammers, and shows powered-machine status tooltips for InterestingME machines.
